entries.title: II Kings 21:2
segments: Men from religious families sometimes commit wickedness far beyond others who have not had pious instruction and example.

entries.title: II Kings 21:6
segments: Observed times; or, practised divination.  Divination and witchcraft, in all their varied forms, were parts of the ancient system of idolatry, as they are of modern systems.

entries.title: II Kings 21:9
segments: Those who break over the restraints of a pious education and become abandoned in wickedness, often go to greater lengths in inquity than even the heathen, and ripen for more aggravated ruin.

entries.title: II Kings 21:12
segments: Both his ears shall tingle; at the dreadfulness of the judgments which God would bring upon them.

entries.title: II Kings 21:13
segments: The line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab; the line and the plummet are here the symbols of God's exact justice in the judgments he inflicts on the wicked.  Compare

.  The meaning of the figure is, that God will execute upon Judah and Jerusalem the same righteous judgments that he has sent upon Samaria and the house of Ahab. 
 
  Wipe Jerusalem; wipe out its inhabitants and its wealth, and utterly overturn it.

entries.title: II Kings 21:21
segments: The wickedness of fathers will be likely to be imitated by their children, and that of rulers by their people; and after having been tempters of each other in this world, they will, if they continue in sin, become tormentors of each other in the world to come.
